title: Fukuda FRE-102B
tagline: A long-range rotary laser level transmitter designed for agricultural land levelling.
cardDescription: A heavy-duty agricultural rotary laser reference for accurate long-range land-levelling work.
description: The Fukuda FRE-102B creates a 360-degree reference for field grading. Fukuda specifies horizontal or vertical rotation, sensor levelling with an out-of-level alarm, directional scanning and a 600 rpm rotation speed for receiver-assisted work.

title: Fukuda FRE-203
tagline: An electronic self-levelling rotary laser with slope and scanning control.
cardDescription: Combines electronic self-levelling, dual-axis slope control and long-range receiver operation.
description: The Fukuda FRE-203 is an electronic self-levelling rotary laser for horizontal and vertical reference work. Its official specification includes dual-axis manual slope, selectable rotation speeds, directional scanning and receiver-assisted operation across large sites.
specs: Horizontal +/-20 arc seconds; vertical +/-20 arc seconds
